requirement: aero_to_mat writes a .mat file to the given path
rationale: Defines the basic write contract for the MATLAB export target

requirement: aero_to_mat writes date and the six reference scalars (Sref Cref Bref Xref Yref Zref) at the top level of the .mat file
rationale: A MATLAB/Simulink consumer needs reference geometry and provenance without traversing nested structs

requirement: aero_to_mat writes shared alpha/beta breakpoints under breakpoints and per-surface deflection breakpoints under breakpoints.defl.<surface>
rationale: alpha/beta are identical across every StabTable by construction so are stored once; defl varies by surface so cannot be

requirement: aero_to_mat writes each total_stab table under stab.<coef> with values matching the source AeroDatabase
rationale: Ensures no silent transposition or truncation when converting numpy arrays into nested MATLAB structs

requirement: aero_to_mat writes each total_ctrl table under ctrl.<surface>.<coef> preserving the (n_alpha n_beta n_defl) shape and values
rationale: 3-D control tables must round-trip through savemat without losing their axis structure

requirement: aero_to_mat includes stab_deriv and ctrl_deriv tables under stab_deriv.<key> and ctrl_deriv.<key>
rationale: A MATLAB/Simulink consumer wants the full picture (derivatives too) not just total coefficients

requirement: aero_to_mat accepts a str path as well as a Path
rationale: Matches the flexible str | Path convention used elsewhere in the package

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 writes a .h5 file to the given path
rationale: Defines the basic write contract for the HDF5 export target

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 writes date and the six reference scalars as top-level datasets (/date /Sref /Cref /Bref /Xref /Yref /Zref)
rationale: Mirrors aero_to_mat's top-level layout so the two export formats present an identical logical hierarchy

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 writes shared alpha/beta breakpoints under /breakpoints and per-surface deflection breakpoints under /breakpoints/defl/<surface>
rationale: Same alpha/beta-once versus per-surface-defl reasoning as the .mat export applied to HDF5 group paths

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 writes each total_stab table as dataset /stab/<coef> with values matching the source AeroDatabase
rationale: Ensures no silent transposition or truncation when writing numpy arrays into HDF5 datasets

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 writes each total_ctrl table as dataset /ctrl/<surface>/<coef> preserving the (n_alpha n_beta n_defl) shape and values and is readable from MATLAB via h5read
rationale: 3-D control tables must round-trip through h5py with a hierarchy MATLAB's h5read can address directly

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 includes stab_deriv and ctrl_deriv tables under /stab_deriv/<key> and /ctrl_deriv/<key>
rationale: A MATLAB/Simulink consumer wants the full picture (derivatives too) not just total coefficients

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 accepts a str path as well as a Path
rationale: Matches the flexible str | Path convention used elsewhere in the package

requirement: aero_to_mat raises ImportError with an actionable pip install avl-aero-tables[export] message when scipy is not installed
rationale: A bare ModuleNotFoundError would not tell an unequipped user how to fix it; scipy is an optional extra not a core dependency

requirement: aero_to_hdf5 raises ImportError with an actionable pip install avl-aero-tables[export] message when h5py is not installed
rationale: A bare ModuleNotFoundError would not tell an unequipped user how to fix it; h5py is an optional extra not a core dependency
